first_reading.quote:
The clock face has standard 1-12 numerals. There are two hands visible from the center: one pointing straight up to 12 (the longer hand, the minute hand), and a shorter hand also pointing up toward 12. There's a red dot at the center pivot.

Looking at the hands: both appear to point to 12. The minute hand is at 12 (top). The hour hand is also at 12. So the time is 12:00.

final_reading.quote: Both hands are pointing straight up at the 12, so the clock shows **12:00**.

note: 首次和最终均把两根指针描述为指向12，读为12:00。
